items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 October 2026 5:24pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 09 October 2026 at 5:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland, with high pressure in the Atlantic extending a ridge across France.


##Wind##

Westerly 5 to 7, veering Northwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but occasionally rough in the east of the area tonight and tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7, gradually decreasing West or Northwest 2 to 4 overnight into Sunday, then backing Southerly Sunday morning. Increasing South or Southeast 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, falling slight tomorrow night, then smooth or slight for a time on Sunday.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
